title: Enforce two-lane factual invariant and memory lineage tracking in routes/memories.py

sections.what: Enforce a Two-Lane Factual Invariant so subjective palimpsest reconsolidation only touches episodic, social, emotional, and narrative beliefs while inventory, spatial_memory topology, door/lock states, and AlreadyKnown grounding stay on an unvarnished deterministic lane, and record raw source observation refs plus generation depth metadata in routes/memories.py.
sections.why: Sub-slice 3 of task-947: prevents subjective memory distortion from hallucinating keys or breaking PlanGrounding, and prevents multi-turn soak cascades by keeping immutable source lineage traceable.
sections.how: Separate deterministic grounding state from Intermediator palimpsest summaries in engine/lived_log_memory.py, action-interpreter.ts, and memory-manager.ts, and store immutable source observation IDs plus generation depth on derived memories exposed via routes/memories.py.
sections.verify: Run multi-turn key/door grounding tests alongside /memories API inspection to confirm spatial/inventory state stays unvarnished and source observation refs + generation depth appear in payloads.

acceptance.text: Deterministic inventory, spatial_memory topology, door/lock states, and AlreadyKnown grounding stay on the unvarnished factual lane
Derived conscious episodic syntheses store immutable raw source observation references and generation depth metadata
GET /memories debug payloads expose raw source lineage alongside varnished conscious syntheses without compounding soak drift

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Mind / Inspector debug panel (backend payload via routes/memories.py)

Current availability: GET /memories route and Inspector memory tab exist; raw source lineage and generation depth fields are planned under task-947.

Why no browser UI: This task adds backend factual-lane separation and lineage fields on routes/memories.py payloads rather than a standalone new UI view.

Alternative verification steps:
1. Call GET /memories in an active scenario with recalled episodic memories and inspect JSON payloads.
   - expected: Payloads include immutable source observation refs and generation depth alongside synthesized conscious summaries, while inventory/spatial facts stay unvarnished.
